query: I just got back from walking my golden retriever puppy earlier, he kept stopping to sniff every dandelion on the sidewalk and even tried to carry a fallen maple leaf home in his mouth. I also spent the afternoon baking chocolate chip cookies for my neighbor’s kid’s birthday, I had to run out to the grocery store halfway through because I realized I was completely out of brown sugar. Oh, and I just finished the latest episode of that new mystery drama everyone’s been talking about, the plot twist at the end totally caught me off guard, I didn’t see it coming at all. Anyway, I need to exchange two delivered order items: first for order #W2905754, replace item 3478699712 with item 9844888101, charge the difference to credit_card_3677959. Second for order #W4073673, replace item 2216662955 with item 9844888101, also charge any difference to credit_card_3677959.
